verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt at https://hyperbrowser.ai/llms.txt (HTTP 200) that describes Hyperbrowser as cloud browsers for AI agents. Many doc pages are also served as raw markdown (.md URLs for sessions, proxy, scrape, crawl, SDKs, pricing), so an agent can be pointed at machine-readable docs directly. Missing for 10: a root docs.md index (404), any evidence of an llms-full.txt or how complete the llms.txt content is, and independent or community confirmation that agents use these docs effectively.
